text_block_list.text:
Despite struggling against formidable
rivals,
Grass Wonder manages to land a
respectable
place in the Japanese
Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's a record we should be proud of, and
yet...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This wasn't enough. How can I be
satisfied if I'm
not at the top of my
generation?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: We'll have to keep training hard.

text_block_list.text: Absolutely, we must.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Grass!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Oh... El.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: This ain't over yet!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We might have duked it out at the
prestigious
Derby...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: But even then! Your running... it was...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: ...Grass.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I'm runnin' in the Japan Cup next.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It's the only G1 in Japan that gets so
many
foreign racers—and I swore I'm
gonna prove I'm
the world's strongest!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: So you better be there too!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: At the Japan Cup?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Sí! You have to!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
You have to let me face you one more
time!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: Do you want to run in the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.text: I had never considered it, honestly.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
When thinking of gaining experience in
the
Classics, the conventional course
would lead me
to the Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
That or perhaps the Autumn Tenno Sho,
taking
my strengths into consideration.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Really? From where I'm standing, you
and El
facing off in the Japan Cup would
be gnarly!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: ...! Maruzen.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Heya! ♪ Nice race! ♪ That was some rad
running
out there!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Like, I totes flipped out! Who'd have
thunk you
cuties could compete with
such fiery passion?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: So, you were watching, then.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Yep! 'Cause the thing is...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I've had my eye on that Эль Кондор Паса
gal for a
little while now. ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: You don't say...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I mean, isn't she adorable? The way she
puts
herself out there with her heart on
her sleeve.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: You know, I almost think...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
El might be more of a "Beast's Successor"
than
you. ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Oh, crap! I forgot I was in the middle of

something.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Bye, Grass! ♪ I'm looking forward to
your next
race!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
After Марузенски leaves, Грасс Вандер
falls very
silent.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Later, on our way back...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I... was being irresolute earlier. I'm sorry.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: But now, my heart is set.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please enter me in the Japan
Cup.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: I am.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
How can I beat Maruzen if I'm not even
fast
enough to be her Successor?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I have to prove my beastly strength once
and for
all.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
As she stands firm under the evening
glow, Grass
Wonder's eyes are alight
with steely
determination.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Our goal is now set: to run in the Japan
Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You just wait, Grass. This next one's
gonna be
mine... I swear it!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Next time, it'll be my silhouette you're
chasin'!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
No matter who it is ya might be fixated
on now!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
